description: Defines the six phases of the Book 4 opacity-revelation evaluation cycle. Each phase has strict entry/exit conditions, active operators, and skip conditions.
phase_sequence: init → measure → threshold → probe → reveal → catalogue

phases.label: init
phases.description: Load Book 1 (FFT) kernel and Book 3 (SD) detection domain. Assert session context. Confirm QMROOT path terminates at 0D. Verify coherence=declared. No OR operators are active in this phase.
phases.exit_condition: coherence=declared; Book 3 SD operators available; QMROOT 0D confirmed
phases.qmroot_check: 6D absent; negative rungs absent; INV-013 = 0D only

phases.label: measure
phases.description: Assign the opacity gradient ω to the target structure via OR-Ω. Declare the observer detection capacity δ via OR-Δ (using SD-Σd as substrate). Both ω and δ must be recorded before the threshold phase begins.
phases.ordering_constraint: OR-Ω and OR-Δ may run in either order within this phase, but both must complete before P-OR-3.
phases.drift_guard: ω must not be assigned using observer attributes. δ must be grounded in SD-Σd output.

phases.label: threshold
phases.description: Execute RevelationCheck (OR-Ρ). Compare δ(O) against ω(S). Assign revelation_state ∈ {opaque, threshold, revealed}. If revealed: skip probe phase, proceed to reveal. If opaque or threshold: proceed to probe.
phases.entry_condition: ω(S) and δ(O) both recorded from P-OR-2

gate_logic.δ = ω: revelation_state = threshold → record event → treat as opaque → proceed to P-OR-4

phases.label: probe
phases.description: Execute LatentProbe (OR-Λ). Enumerate sub(S). Evaluate each s_i against δ. Classify S_latent and S_access. Detect structural shadows within S_access. Record latent_set and shadow_set.
phases.sub_structure_requirement: All s_i must have ω(s_i) assigned before OR-Λ executes.
phases.shadow_handling: Structural shadows are recorded in shadow_set. They are passed to OR-Π but do not constitute revelation.
phases.skip_condition: Skip when revelation_state = revealed (all sub-structures fully revealed — S_latent = ∅)

phases.label: reveal
phases.description: Execute PartialIndex (OR-Π). For each s_i ∈ sub(S), assign state_i ∈ {revealed, opaque, shadow}. Construct revelation_map: { s_i → state_i }. Identify partial revelation if 0 < |S_access| < |sub(S)|.
phases.entry_condition: S_latent, S_access, shadow_set available from P-OR-4 (or revelation_state = revealed from P-OR-3)
phases.exit_condition: revelation_map complete; partial revelation flag set if applicable
phases.shadow_in_map: Sub-structures in shadow_set that are not in S_access are mapped to state = shadow
phases.skip_condition: Skip revelation_map construction for atomic structures with no sub(S)

phases.label: catalogue
phases.description: Record the final revelation_map, ω(S), δ(O), revelation_state, and partial_revelation_flag to the session log. Flag structural shadows for potential Book 3 re-investigation. Mark OR cycle complete.
phases.exit_condition: cycle_complete = true; all results logged; Book 3 re-investigation flags set if shadow_set is non-empty

downstream_handoffs.Book_5_TEL: revelation_map feeds TEL encoding for OR-qualified structures
downstream_handoffs.Book_6_Governance: opacity profile (ω, revelation_state, shadow_set) feeds regime opacity analysis
downstream_handoffs.Book_8_NoS: structural opacity properties feed ontological analysis of concealment

phase_skip_rules.P-OR-4_skip: Applies when revelation_state = revealed from P-OR-3 (no latent structure to probe)
phase_skip_rules.P-OR-5_atomic_skip: Applies when sub(S) = ∅ (atomic structure). ω(S) and revelation_state are sufficient.
